files.README.md:
# Lumenhaus Lighting - April 2026 billing extract

orders_april.csv is the order register for April 2026 and
refunds_april.csv lists refunds issued against those orders. Each refund
amount is stored as a positive figure and reduces the revenue recognized
on the referenced order. Amounts are in USD.
